records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the accepted short caption. The commands that address him by FI or FA use the native player substitution.
Julio Erneco is the crewmate who independently confirms Angelo's advice about market share.
Angelo Puccini gives the same full name after the duel. His boasts and trade advice belong to the same speaker.
Gerhard Adernkatz serves as Hodram's officer and continues with him when he retires. His own name stays separate from the offices discussed.
Al Shin is the registered caption. He gives only Al in the first introduction, which suits the new acquaintance.
Charles Rochefort notices Al and offers an opinion about teamwork. He has his own alternate delivery in the lamp scene.
Carlo Sinat gives the same full name when accepting the offer. Purser is the position Hodram offers him in speech.
Fernando Dias makes the joke about being observant. The registered F stays in the ordinary English font.
Ian Dukov appears on the nameplate and in Ian's own introduction. The harassing forms of address belong to the patrons' speech.
Manuel Almeida greets Hodram when he returns from the palace. The congratulations stay in Manuel's voice.
Sera Shahrbaraz is the regular caption before the farewell. Sera and her addresses to Hodram in the speakerless staged exchanges are embedded in the panels.
Yifa Sol gives her own explanation for trying the lamp. Her name stays distinct from Charles on the alternative branch.
Sirwood Eme addresses the party in Abkhaz. Preserve his caption separately from the staged farewell.
Barkeep expresses the source tavern role in familiar English. Ian's respectful response needs no implication of kinship.
Patron is the anonymous customer. The later attack adds no personal name or rank to the standing caption.
Trader reflects Adil's shared source role. Carlo and Adil's wife identify him by name aloud.
Port Worker is the source dock role that relays the Alexandria summons.
Port Worker is the separate regional role that brings the rumor of a new Black Sea town.
Guard is the palace role. His announcement there does not give him a personal name.
Guard identifies the distinct regional actor who checks the company name at the Alexandria audience.
King expresses the monarch's role in the palace audience. Hodram uses the proper form of address in speech.
Officiant is the source ceremonial role. The man withholds his own name in the dialogue.
Innkeeper is the actor's shared Japanese role. Her relationship to Adil is clear in speech and does not need to be added to the standing caption.
Guildmaster is the source guild role. The man can be Al's employer without adding a military rank.
Sailor is the existing caption for the shared source subordinate. In the ambush his conduct establishes that he is one of the attackers.
Man is the established caption for the anonymous male half of the couple. The couple designation stays out of the conversational nameplate.
Woman is the established caption for the anonymous female half of the couple. Her lines identify who she is talking about.
